NUTRITION
  GUIDELINES:
    - energy_target: "maintenance + 300..500 kcal to support breastfeeding; avoid aggressive deficits until milk supply is stable"
    - protein: "1.6..2.0 g/kg bodyweight daily from lean meats, dairy, eggs, legumes; distribute across 3..5 meals"
    - carbohydrates: "focus on complex carbs and fiber; include whole grains, fruits, vegetables"
    - fats: "emphasize omega-3 sources (fish, flax, chia); limit trans fats"
    - hydration: "aim 2.5..3.5 L fluids daily; add 250..500 ml around feeds and workouts"
    - micronutrients: "iron, calcium, iodine, choline, vitamin D, B12; continue prenatal per OB guidance"
    - caffeine: "limit to <= 200 mg/day"
    - alcohol: "minimize; if consumed, time after a feed and wait 2..3 hours"
    - meal_timing: "eat every 3..4 hours; protein at each meal/snack"
    - fiber: "25..35 g/day; increase gradually and hydrate"
    - weight_change: "slow, if any, <= 0.25 kg/week after 8..12 weeks and only if supply is stable"
  SAMPLE_DAY:
    - meal_1: "Greek yogurt, oats, berries, chia; water"
    - snack_1: "Apple with peanut butter; water"
    - meal_2: "Whole grain wrap with chicken, avocado, greens; milk or fortified alt"
    - snack_2: "Cottage cheese with pineapple; water"
    - meal_3: "Salmon, quinoa, roasted vegetables, olive oil; water"
    - snack_3: "Trail mix or hummus with carrots; herbal tea"
  NOTES:
    - breastfeeding_support: "monitor supply, hunger, fatigue; adjust calories by 100..200 kcal as needed"
    - supplementation: "confirm vitamin D and DHA/EPA with provider; continue prenatal if advised"
    - food_safety: "avoid high-mercury fish; reheat leftovers thoroughly"

NOTES
  CORE_RULES:
    - clearance: "Weeks 1..4 no abs per OB; begin deep core in Week 5 only after 6-week check and symptom-free"
    - progression: "start with bird_dog and dead_bug; add plank and side_plank Weeks 7..8; gentle flexion like reverse_crunch Week 9+ if no doming/pain"
    - stop_signs: "stop and regress if bulging/doming, incision pain, bleeding increase, pelvic heaviness, leakage"
  HIIT_RULES:
    - start_window: "earliest Week 9 as low-impact intervals (brisk walking); keep rpe 6..7"
    - frequency: "limit to 1 HIIT-style cardio per week; separate 24h from heavy lower sessions"
    - modality: "low-impact only (walking or incline walking); avoid running, jumping, burpee, squat_jump, box_jump until ≥ 12 weeks and symptom-free"
